'''''Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell''''' is a comic series written by [[Ryder Windham]] and drawn by [[Ramón F. Bachs]], starring [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The series is composed of 3 issues released in December [[2000]], and in February and March [[2001]].
